signature: SUBROUTINE ZTREXC( COMPQ, N, T, LDT, Q, LDQ, IFST, ILST, INFO )

params.name: compq
params.reference:
-   `= 'V'`: update the matrix Q of Schur vectors;
-   `= 'N'`: do not update Q.

params.name: N
params.reference: The order of the matrix T. $N \ge 0$. If N == 0 arguments `ILST` and `IFST` may be any value.

params.name: T
params.reference: On entry, the upper triangular matrix T. On exit, the reordered upper triangular matrix.

params.name: ldt
params.reference: The leading dimension of the array T. $\mathrm{LDT} \ge \max (1,N)$.

params.name: Q
params.reference: On entry, if `COMPQ = 'V'`, the matrix Q of Schur vectors. On exit, if `COMPQ = 'V'`, Q has been postmultiplied by the unitary transformation matrix Z which reorders T. If `COMPQ = 'N'`, Q is not referenced.

params.name: ldq
params.reference: The leading dimension of the array Q. $\mathrm{LDQ} \ge 1$, and if `COMPQ = 'V'`, $\mathrm{LDQ} \ge \max (1,N)$.

params.name: ilst
params.reference: Specify the reordering of the diagonal elements of T: The element with row index `IFST` is moved to row `ILST` by a sequence of transpositions between adjacent elements. $1 \le \mathrm{IFST} \le N$; $1 \le \mathrm{ILST} \le N$.

params.name: info
params.reference:
-   `= 0`: successful exit
-   `< 0`: if `INFO = -i`, the i-th argument had an illegal value
